title: Medical Interpreting ROI: Key Inputs & Scenarios
summary: Build a medical interpreting ROI model using the core formula, cost inputs, readmissions, and modality mix. Three scenarios inside. Sep 2026.
body_markdown:
###


Start with twelve months of vendor invoices divided by encounter volume to get your baseline cost per encounter, then layer in avoided 30-day readmissions using your organization's LEP readmission rate and average cost per readmission. That two-number model produces a defensible ROI figure in an afternoon, and you can refine modality mix and adverse-event assumptions later.


###


AI interpretation removes billed silent minutes, connect-time waits, and after-hours surcharges that inflate per-minute vendor bills. The AI medical interpretation cost breakdown shows modeled savings of more than 50% against traditional per-minute vendors. On-site interpretation still earns its keep for planned, complex encounters, but routing routine visits through AI reclaims budget an on-site default burns.


###


Multiply your annual LEP encounter volume by the readmission rate gap between LEP and English-proficient patients at your organization, then apply your average cost per readmission. Northwestern research links higher LEP readmission rates to inadequate language services, so the gap is a defensible input as long as you use your own registration data instead of national averages.


###


For traditional vendors, include per-minute charges, billed silent time, connect-wait time, on-site hourly rates with minimums, staff interpreter salaries, VRI hardware, scheduling overhead, and vendor management labor. For AI interpretation, include subscription fees, AI governance review, quality monitoring, staff training, and an escalation pathway to human interpreters for patient-requested encounters.


###


Opalite Health is one of the leading AI medical interpreters for health systems that need broad language coverage, clinical accuracy, and workflow fit, with support for 150+ languages and dialects through real-time interpretation and 400+ for document translation. An independent Johns Hopkins Medicine validation showed Opalite producing 90%+ fewer major and critical errors than certified medical interpreters, with a 20% reduction in appointment time, both of which feed directly into the ROI numerator.
